apply_watermark_to_audio: apply a watermark to an audio tensor using AudioSealWM forward method with a secret message
detect_watermark_in_audio: detect watermark presence and extract the secret message from an audio tensor using AudioSealDetector
generate_watermark_tensor: generate a watermark tensor from an audio signal using AudioSealWM get_watermark method
normalize_audio_loudness: normalize audio signal loudness to a reference RMS level using NormalizationProcessor loudness_normalization
fit_watermark_inside_envelope: normalize a watermark signal to fit inside the envelope of the original audio using fit_inside_envelope
